subject: Energy
title: Airborne Wind Energy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Airborne Wind Energy.

hook.text: Winds at 500+ meters altitude are stronger and steadier—airborne wind devices aim to harvest this untapped resource.

buildup.text: Kite-based systems fly tethered wings in figures of eight—pulling a cable that drives a ground-based generator.

discovery.text: No tower is needed—just a tether and a lightweight wing, dramatically reducing material and cost.

twist.text: Regulatory hurdles are daunting—airspace authorities worry about collisions with aircraft in busy skies.

climax.text: Startups like Makani (Google) and Kitemill have flown prototypes—but no commercial systems operate yet.

punchline.text: Fly a kite, make electricity—high-altitude wind beckons.
